_source: Phase 5 · Slice 4 (content + balance). The curated VERDANT-FRINGE slice roster — ~25 creatures selected BY ID from client/catalog/species.json (the 406-species DB, generated from docs/creature_registry.csv). This file is DATA ONLY: it names which existing catalog ids the MVP slice uses + their wild-encounter weights + the starter party + the legendary boss + the deterministic boss-trigger config. It computes nothing; species data is always read through SpeciesCatalog. Per docs/Mutants_Game_MVP_Slice.md: the Verdant fringe is Eros/Gaia-tilted (gentle, forgiving onboarding) — ~18 T1/T2 wild, ~5 T3, + 1 Legendary boss (the region climax). Every id here MUST exist in species.json (asserted by the encounter pool test).

boss.name: Core-golem
boss._note: The Verdant fringe's Legendary climax (Gaia/Cosmos apex tank, boss-tagged in the registry; Bestiary lists it as an apex region-guardian). Driven by a strong role brain (CombatBrain.assign_role) — the full Succession HSM is reserved for god-tier. A fresh starter party cannot solo it (intended wall); the player grows first.

boss_trigger._note: Deterministic region climax: the boss fight fires once the player has explored at least `min_steps` overworld steps in the region. Step-indexed + seeded so the trigger is a pure function of (run.seed, region, step) — same as the wild-encounter roll. Reproducible across save/load. The cleared flag stops it re-firing.
